in_marathi.name: Anshumat
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Peace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anshumat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anshumat is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'anshu', which means 'desire'. The name Anshumat is believed to refer to the god of peace and prosperity, Lord Anshuman. According to Hindu mythology, Lord Anshuman is the son of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati. He is often depicted holding a trishula (a three-pronged weapon) and is believed to bestow peace, happiness, and prosperity upon his devotees.
